csv_project_name: LLB For Everett ES - New Cafeteria & Site Improv
csv_scope_of_work: The purpose of this RFQ/P is to assemble a pool of qualified persons, firms, partnerships, corporations, associations, or professional organizations to provide constructability review, value engineering, master scheduling, cost estimating, budgeting, and construction services for the development and construction for New Cafeteria Buildings and Site Improvements at Everett, Enslen, Rose Avenue and Sonoma Elementary Schools Project ( Project ), in accordance with the lease leaseback structure set forth in Education Code section 17406 et seq. Selected developer shall have experience with the construction of public school facilities and complying with the requirements of the Office of Public School Construction ( OPSC ), the Division of the State Architect ( DSA ), and Title 24 of the California Code of Regulations.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Design Build/Developer, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Value Engineering

title: Lease-Leaseback for Everett ES - New Cafeteria and Site Improvements
short_description: Lease-leaseback delivery for new elementary school cafeterias and related site improvements.
project_scope: Development and construction of new cafeteria buildings and site improvements at four elementary schools: Everett, Enslen, Rose Avenue, and Sonoma Elementary Schools. The procurement is structured as a lease-leaseback developer selection for public school facilities and includes compliance with OPSC, DSA, and Title 24 requirements. Total stated construction cost is 8.8 million USD.
services: Lease-leaseback developer services including constructability review, value engineering, master scheduling, cost estimating, budgeting, and construction services; disciplines requested include architecture services, design-build/developer, rehabilitation and refurbishment, construction/project management, cost estimating, and value engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a developer/construction procurement, not a structural design tender.
- Project type is standard school cafeteria buildings and site improvements, with no special spans or structural innovation indicated.
- Requested services focus on construction delivery, budgeting, scheduling, and value engineering rather than engineering design.
- Buildings appear relatively small and conventional, offering limited strategic fit for sbp.
- Some early-stage planning component exists, but overall relevance remains low.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated. The notice is for lease-leaseback developer services covering constructability review, value engineering, scheduling, estimating, budgeting, and construction. Because the procurement is not a clearly defined structural engineering commission, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Selected developer must have experience with construction of public school facilities and compliance with the Office of Public School Construction (OPSC), the Division of the State Architect (DSA), and Title 24 of the California Code of Regulations. The RFQ/P seeks qualified persons, firms, partnerships, corporations, associations, or professional organizations.
